lines.text: Alamo Injury Law, this is Boris, the firm's AI assistant. This call is recorded. How can I help?
Hey, it's Andre Wallace. Just checking where my case is at.
Hi Andre, I have your file. You're in treatment, and we've asked the ER for your records. Nothing's needed from you right now.
I'll text you this update, and I'll let Lupe, your case manager, know you called.
